title: TorusGuardRetestRecord
description: Schema for explicit retest execution, fix verification, and closure status in TorusGuard v0.5.1.

retest_performed.description: True if an automated or manual retest has been executed on the post-fix codebase.

fix_applied.description: Summary of the code patch or configuration change applied.

retest_method.description: Method used to verify resolution (e.g. differential static recheck, automated unit test).

retest_evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the modified source file confirming post-fix state.

closure_status.description: Final verified operational status of the finding.

residual_risk.description: Any residual operational or architectural risk remaining after the fix.

verifier_notes.description: Human or AI verifier notes detailing retest observations.
